from typing import Literal
import mas_operators as operator
from . import prompt as prompt_custom
from scripts.async_llm import create_llm_instance


from scripts.evaluator import DatasetType

class Workflow:
    def __init__(
        self,
        name: str,
        llm_config,
        dataset: DatasetType,
        aggregator_llm_config=None,
    ) -> None:
        self.name = name
        self.dataset = dataset
        self.llm = create_llm_instance(llm_config)
        self.aggregator_llm = create_llm_instance(aggregator_llm_config) if aggregator_llm_config else self.llm

    async def __call__(self, problem: str):
        star = operator.Star(worker_llm=self.llm, aggregator_llm=self.aggregator_llm, num_agents=3, worker_prompts=[prompt_custom.SUDOKU_STAR_WORKER] * 3, aggregator_prompt=prompt_custom.SUDOKU_STAR_AGG)
        draft = await star(problem)
        seq = operator.Sequential(llm=self.aggregator_llm, num_rounds=2, prompts=[prompt_custom.SUDOKU_REPAIR_THEN_SOLVE, prompt_custom.SUDOKU_PLAIN_CODEBLOCK_FORMAT])
        solution = await seq(f"Original puzzle:\n{problem}\n\nCandidate solution:\n{draft['response']}")
        return solution["response"], {"worker": self.llm.get_usage_delta(), "aggregator": self.aggregator_llm.get_usage_delta()}
